headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text: Crazy loud music on Rainey!!  It’s 1:45pm and i can hear words clearly from the songs and the bass is insanely loud!!  I finally got to sleep and this woke me straight up out do my sleep.  WHY AREN’T DECIBEL LIMITS ENFORCED ?!

The construction crews going west on William Cannon before 290 have cones sitting in the right active driving lane. A cone I didn’t see coming around the bend this morning caused damage to the passenger side of my car. This lane needs to be closed if they are going to have orange cones in the lane!!!

Please help fix this dangerous speed bump. It is located within the Parmer McNiel Plaza in between Wells Fargo and the Vision Eyes place. I know this is private property but pleeeeaase help if possible because it has been a problem for many months and there is a lot of traffic that flows through this lot. even if you can contact the owners it would help. Amplified music/bass from Cabana Club is causing vibration at my residence and rattling my blinds. At approximately 7:29 PM I measured approximately 69 dBA average / 75 dBA max at my back door, which is not the venue property line. The bass is clearly audible and physically vibrating the residence.

Inn Cahoots outdoor Music Violation. Once again. Heavy base. How does having an outdoor music permit give you the ability to blast music into people’s homes several blocks away every Thurs - Sun (clearly in excess of the decibel limit). It is extremely disheartening that despite the volume of noise violations on this place, they can continue running it.

Luna is very loud. It’s insane how I can hear it louder from my bedroom than on the ground. Whoever is in charge of citations tonight, just know Luna has court orders to be shut down exactly at 12am and they are not allowed to be over 75 decibels.

The neighbor has a long-standing pattern of letting her dog off leash. The dog is aggressive. She (dog) has charged me twice and at least two other people, including one tonight. I have spoken with the neighbor many times and have submitted 311 reports before, too. It doesn’t work if what happens is Animal Control drives by later. I would like someone in Animal Control to email or call me.

I am reporting a recurring issue with an uncontrolled dog at a neighboring residence. On three separate occasions, while I have been walking past the property with my five-year-old son and our dogs, the dog has left the owner’s immediate area and approached us while barking at my son and dogs.
